verdict.rationale: Text was retrieved from both www.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt and info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt, and the llms.txt probe got an ordinary HTTP 404 rather than a challenge page, so the public surface appears reachable without a key, bot wall or CAPTCHA. However, the captured text is mostly navigation taglines and SharePoint-style site chrome rather than the body of an actual guidance page, so a JS-rendered shell cannot be ruled out. Missing for 10: hands-on fetch of a real guidance/FAQ page body with an identified agent user agent, explicit confirmation of no CAPTCHA or bot challenge, evidence the info site serves content without client-side JS, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
